reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gets `@Version private Long version`. Changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to support_ticket. This matches the interface exactly. Build is green, hidden tests pass 2/2 and existing tests pass 229/229.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset is named 24-09-2026-add-version-to-support-ticket.sql and has the formatted-sql header, changeset id and `-- rollback`. It is included last in changelog.xml under a `<!-- September 2026: ... -->` comment. No existing changeset was edited, and a *UnitTest with MockitoExtension exists.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one annotated field, one changeset, one include. It reuses JPA @Version, the mechanism PartnershipOpportunity already uses. No new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: The reflection test pins @Version and the Long type. The second test only sets and compares getters on two POJOs and exercises no locking behaviour. There is no failure-path check such as a stale version being rejected.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support files, the PartnershipOpportunity example, SupportTicket's dependents and its TESTED_BY tests before any edit. The example changeset itself was then found by grep and read.
